title: The 4 Best Portable Tire Inflators for Road Trips
h1: The 4 Best Portable Tire Inflators for Road Trips
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for portable tire inflators for road trips, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at portable tire inflators for road trips using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: VIAIR 400P Portable Compressor Kit
products.blurb: Key specs: 150 PSI maximum pressure, 33% duty cycle at 20 minutes continuous run, IP54 dust and water resistance rating.
strengths: Handles full-size truck and SUV tires without straining, unlike glovebox-size pumps
33% duty cycle means it can air up all four tires in one stop without overheating
IP54 sealing shrugs off rain and road grime better than unsealed budget inflators
limitations: Case is sized for a trunk, not a glovebox
26-amp draw wants the engine running, not just the battery
features: 150 PSI maximum pressure
33% duty cycle at 20 minutes continuous run
IP54 dust and water resistance rating
Inflates a 35-inch tire from 0 to 30 PSI in under 6 minutes
Direct-drive gearless motor

products.name: DEWALT DCC020IB 20V MAX Tire Inflator
products.blurb: Key specs: Runs on 20V MAX battery, 12V DC, or 110V AC, Automatic shut-off at a set PSI, Screw-on Schrader chuck.
strengths: Works even if the car battery is too weak to power a 12V pump
Doubles as a garage inflator between trips
limitations: Needs an existing 20V MAX battery to use the cordless mode
features: Runs on 20V MAX battery, 12V DC, or 110V AC
Automatic shut-off at a set PSI
Screw-on Schrader chuck
LED work light
Sold as a bare tool

products.name: EPAuto 12V DC Portable Air Compressor
products.blurb: Key specs: Digital gauge in PSI, KPA, BAR, and KG/CM2, Auto shut-off at a preset target pressure, Built-in LED flashlight.
strengths: Small enough to leave in the glovebox permanently
Auto shut-off means you don't have to watch the gauge on the shoulder
limitations: Not rated for light truck or heavy-duty tires
Recommended 10-minute duty cycle before a cooldown
features: Digital gauge in PSI, KPA, BAR, and KG/CM2
Auto shut-off at a preset target pressure
Built-in LED flashlight
12V DC cigarette lighter plug
Rated for car, bike, and midsize SUV tires

products.name: Kensun AC/DC Rapid Performance Digital Tire Inflator
products.blurb: Key specs: Dual power: 12V DC car socket and 110V AC wall outlet, 120W solid metal motor, Backlit digital gauge in PSI, BAR, and KPA.
strengths: The only inflator here that also plugs straight into a hotel room outlet
Metal motor runs quieter than plastic-geared budget pumps
Backlit display reads clearly in a dark parking lot
limitations: Slower on large truck tires than the VIAIR 400P
AC cord connection is a recurring complaint in long-term owner reports
Carry case fits snugly and can be fiddly to repack
features: Dual power: 12V DC car socket and 110V AC wall outlet
